professionalSummary: Programme manager with four years of experience leading the migration of 38,000 private‑client accounts to a vendor wealth‑management platform, managing scope, vendor milestones, cutover decisions, and client communication plans.
experienceHighlights: Led delivery of a large‑scale platform migration at Ashgrove Investment Partners (Apr 2020‑Jul 2024).
Approved scope changes up to ten person‑days under delegated authority and escalated larger changes to the executive sponsor with an options paper.
Chaired weekly milestone reviews with the platform vendor and data‑conversion contractor, recording slippage against the contract schedule and agreeing recovery dates.
Made the go decision for the final migration weekend in March 2024 against the charter’s cutover criteria; entered the decision in the decision log and countersigned by the executive sponsor.
Authored the timeline and FAQ sections of the client‑communication plan, which the marketing team prepared and owned.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Programme charter excerpts showing delivery lead role and ten person‑day approval limit.
Four pages of the decision log showing sign‑offs on scope changes and the March 2024 cutover decision.
